LanguageData.USAC_Bodybag.tips.0: USAC trades in credit bonds rather than the silver everyone else on the rim uses.
LanguageData.USAC_Bodybag.tips.1: When trading with USAC merchants, make sure your sealed bags are inside trade beacon range.
LanguageData.USAC_Bodybag.tips.2: Body bags only store and transport corpses - they don't preserve them. Build cold storage to slow decay, because USAC will not buy rotten corpses.
LanguageData.USAC_Bodybag.tips.3: A body bag's value depends on the condition of the corpse inside. Recovering bodies quickly and refrigerating them pays far better than leaving them out in the open.
LanguageData.USAC_Bodybag.tips.4: Only bags that already contain a corpse count toward your currency. Empty bags are worth nothing in trade.
LanguageData.USAC_Bond.tips.0: USAC trades in credit bonds rather than the silver everyone else on the rim uses.
LanguageData.USAC_Bond.tips.1: USAC takes bonds first in any trade. Buying new bonds with bonds can incur a "depreciation fee," so keep your reserves in a vault with its trade beacon switched off.
LanguageData.USAC_Bond.tips.2: A credit bond is issued at a value of 1000, but dealers sell them at a premium. How large that premium is depends on your goodwill with USAC.
LanguageData.USAC_Bond.tips.3: Most USAC services draw bonds from trade beacon range only, not from your whole map. Keep reserves outside beacon range if you want them left alone.
LanguageData.USAC_Bond.tips.4: If you run debt contracts and leased services on the same map, keep a buffer of spare bonds so the two don't collide on settlement day.
LanguageData.USAC_Debt.tips.0: USAC charges interest every 30 days - one corporate quarter. Make sure your colony has enough credit bonds on hand when settlement day arrives.
LanguageData.USAC_Debt.tips.1: Repaying more than 10% of the total principal in a single quarter incurs a surcharge that scales with the amount.
LanguageData.USAC_Debt.tips.2: If you can't pay down the principal, at least keep enough income coming in to cover the quarterly interest.
LanguageData.USAC_Debt.tips.3: USAC grants two grace periods on unpaid interest. The third default triggers forced collection.
LanguageData.USAC_Debt.tips.4: If your debt is about to become unpayable, consider leaving this planet while you still can.
LanguageData.USAC_Mech.tips.0: Heavy mining rigs pollute continuously while they run. Planning cleanup and isolation zones early keeps the mess away from your colony core.
LanguageData.USAC_Mech.tips.1: Heavy mining rig leases can be extended with bonds. If money is tight, keep the rig running and rebuild your reserves next trade cycle.
LanguageData.USAC_Mech.tips.2: Mech readiness falls over time, and very low readiness carries penalties. Steady resupply beats emergency refits.
LanguageData.USAC_Mech.tips.3: Each resupply restores about 25% of a mech's maximum readiness. A dedicated resupply area with parts on hand cuts frontline downtime sharply.
LanguageData.USAC_Mech.tips.4: Air-dropped USAC units and equipment need clear ground to land on. If your base is crowded, keep some open tiles in reserve so drops don't fail or drift.
